title: Product Requirements Document
description: Defines the structure for PRD files used by the agent orchestrator. Each property below includes documentation about its role in the PRD.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema definition, following semantic versioning.

version.description: Version of the PRD content, matching release or draft numbering.

project.description: Project identifier or name this PRD describes.

description.description: High-level summary of the work covered by the PRD.

scope.description: Clarifies what work is in scope and out of scope.

decisions.description: Key architectural or policy decisions stemming from this PRD.

id.description: Decision identifier, typically D followed by digits.

decision.description: Text of the decision being recorded.

rationale.description: Motivation explaining why the decision was made.

stories.description: Detailed user stories/tasks that need to be delivered.

escalations.description: Optional list of escalations, approvals, or outstanding questions.

artifacts.description: Artifacts (docs, scripts, configs) produced or referenced by the PRD.

context.description: Additional context such as references to repositories, scripts, or docs.

idPattern.description: Generic ID pattern for decisions and stories.

story.description: Story metadata including verification, priority, status, and estimates.

id.description: Story ID, prefixed with S followed by digits.

title.description: Concise, descriptive title for the story.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the work or goal.

status.description: Current execution status of the story. Common legacy labels like 'open' should be mapped to the nearest enum value.

priority.description: Priority level (1 highest, 5 lowest) and legacy textual labels.

estimate_min.description: Lower bound of time estimate in hours, decimals permitted.

estimate_max.description: Upper bound of time estimate in hours, decimals permitted.

dependencies.description: IDs of stories that must be delivered before this one.

owners.description: Team members responsible for delivering the story.
